decision: Landing zone changes must use a merged parameter-file PR, except eight-hour exemptions granted through lz-flow-create-policy-exemption.
why: Changes outside the parameter file or temporary-exemption workflow leave the landing zone's configuration untracked.
steps: Collect the application, environment, and requested change: cost, tags, or exemptions.
Locate the parameter file and its deployment workflow. If either is missing, stop the update and resolve provisioning through create-landing-zone.
For exemptions, ask whether the request is temporary or long-lived.

For a temporary exemption, collect the policy selection and subscription ID, present the eight-hour scope, and wait for confirmation. Dispatch lz-flow-create-policy-exemption and end this branch; no parameter-file edit or PR is required.
For cost, draft a change to the single budget value; additional alert thresholds are out of scope.
For tags, draft changes to subscriptionLevelTags and resourceLevelTags. Preserve ownerEmail and engineerEmail as readEnvironmentVariable references, with ownerEmail at subscription level.
For a long-lived exemption, draft an exemptions entry referencing a policy-assignment-reference.json key.
For parameter-file changes, present the complete draft and wait for permission to implement.
Apply the approved changes and open a PR. Merge redeploys the landing-zone stack with deleteAll.

links.note: There is no parameter file to edit until the landing zone has been provisioned.

violations: Exemption entry naming a literal ARM assignment ID.
